qualification.package: Clean public wheel/sdist, both unprivileged image imports and visible source, audio/FP8 APIs, complete-pipeline dependencies and CLI verified. Offline wheel/source layers reuse immutable 0.11.0 dependencies, with no model weights.
qualification.engine: Two five-second RTX4090 native BF16 block-ring pairs kept all 120 decoded frames: 1024-square audio-only and 512-square with application face repair. Added audio passes took 55.12 and 33.98 seconds; total request and initialization scopes are documented in the pipeline guide. CPU checks cover transfer-pair rebinding, temporary residual removal, attention ownership and failure restoration. Release-version changes after the qualified algorithm do not alter its inference code.
qualification.limits: This extends explicit SM89 block-ring execution, not default activation or existing geometry/capacity limits. Spatial context thinning remains approximate; the two local cases do not establish general audio-quality improvement, fine lip synchronization, a 15-percent overhead target or larger/longer local audio capacity. Public images have CPU/dependency/CLI checks, not a new GPU image matrix. Application assets, scheduling and deployment remain separate.
